_note: Draft English rendering of Saadia's JA Tafsir on Shemot 23, generated by scripts/translate_tafsir_english.py against the JA (not the biblical Hebrew). Translation goal: reverse-translatability for the Tafsir reader — readers should be able to map English back to JA. Saadia-specific moves preserved per data-source/saadia-gloss-table.json; Blau's notes (data-source/blau-genesis-notes.json) consulted for Bereshit 1-12.

translations.1: And do not accept a false report, and do not associate with a wrongdoer to be for him a witness of injustice.
translations.2: Do not be a follower of the many toward evil, and do not respond in a dispute so as to tilt it — rather, behind the majority, then incline.
translations.3: And do not show favor to the poor in his dispute.
translations.4: And if you come upon the ox of your enemy, or his donkey, going astray — return it to him, a returning.
translations.5: And if you see the donkey of one who hates you crouching under its load, then refrain from leaving it thus — rather, unload it, unload it along with him.
translations.6: Do not tilt the judgment of your poor in his dispute.
translations.7: From false speech, keep far. And the righteous and the innocent — do not kill them; for I will not acquit a wrongdoer.
translations.8: And do not take a bribe; for a bribe blinds the eyes of those who see away from the truth, and falsifies words that are just.
translations.9: And do not oppress a stranger; for you know the soul of the stranger, seeing how long you were strangers in the land of Egypt.
translations.10: Six years you shall sow your land, and gather its produce.
translations.11: But in the seventh you shall leave it and not scatter seed in it; and the poor of your people shall eat from it, and what remains of it the wild creatures of the desert shall eat. So shall you do with your vineyard and your olive grove.
translations.12: Six days you shall perform your labors, and on the seventh day you shall keep the Sabbath — that your ox and your donkey may rest, and the son of your maidservant and the stranger with you may find ease.
translations.13: And all that I have told you, keep; and the name of other objects of worship do not mention, and let it not be heard from your mouth.
translations.14: Three times you shall make pilgrimage to Me in the year.
translations.15: And the festival of unleavened bread — keep it: seven days you shall eat unleavened bread as I commanded you, at the time of the month of the roasting of the barley; for in it you went out from Egypt. And do not appear before Me empty-handed.
translations.16: And the festival of the harvest, of the firstfruits of your labor which you sow in the open country; and the festival of the ingathering, at the going out of the year, when you gather in your labors from the open country.
translations.17: Three times in the year shall all your men appear before the Lord God.
translations.18: And do not slaughter My Passover offering upon leavened bread; and do not let the fat of My festival offering remain until morning.
translations.19: And the first of the firstfruits of your land — bring them to the house of God your Lord. And do not cook meat with milk.
translations.20: Behold, I am sending an angel before you to guard you on the way, and to bring you to the place which I have prepared for you.
translations.21: Be wary of him, and accept his command and do not oppose him; for he will not pardon your transgression — for My name is with him.
translations.22: For if you accept his command and do all that I say, I will be an enemy to those who are enemies to you, and I will harm those who harm you.
translations.23: And when My angel goes before you and brings you in to the Amorites and the Hittites and the Perizzites and the Canaanites, the Hivites and the Jebusites — and I annihilate them,
translations.24: do not bow down to their objects of worship and do not serve them, and do not act as their deeds — rather, demolish them with a demolishing, and break their altars with a breaking.
translations.25: And serve God your Lord; and He will bless your food and your drink, and will remove diseases from you.
translations.26: There shall be none who loses young and none barren in your land; and the count of your days — I will complete them.
translations.27: And I will send My dread before you, and I will throw into confusion all the people unto whom you come; and I will make your enemies turn their backs before you.
translations.28: And I will send the plague before you, and it shall drive out the Hivites and the Canaanites and the Hittites from before you.
translations.29: I will not drive them out from before you in a single year, lest the land become desolate and the wild creatures of the desert multiply against you.
translations.30: But little by little I will drive them out from before you, until you grow and take possession of the land.
translations.31: And I will set your border from the Sea of Qulzum (Red Sea) to the Sea of Philistia, and from the wilderness to the Euphrates; for I will deliver into your hands the inhabitants of the land, and you shall drive them out from before you.
translations.32: Do not make a covenant with them, nor with their objects of worship, a covenant.
translations.33: And they shall not dwell in your land, lest they lead you astray from Me by your serving their objects of worship — for they would be to you a noose.
